text: Friends mostly. I think the exchange with brother was for VVG

I think Harry Potter series is just too close my heart but after all the what JKR is doing is so heinous honestly that I have stopped watching anything new in that universe that is coming out. It still does not cloud my relationship with the series but I just won't pay any more money too her..same thing with Gaiman when the whole thing went down I spent so much time on the Gaiman subreddit and it was so great to hear everyone talking about their relationship with the text and still distancing themselves saying that they are not going to buy new things but the relationship from the text may not change because when you are reading something you are combining your own interpretations and own experiences to that text making it in someways your own...I liked that idea, because Harry Potter was that for me...many a nights falling asleep to reading those books...JKR cannot take that away from me 😅
Not going to burn gaiman books but if someone still wants to read it they can borrow what I have so we are not giving him money 🤷🏽‍♀️

Harry Potter is what the character is to me.
JKR might as well be JaiKishan Rathod for all that matters

There's a Neruda poem very close to a part of my life, and this makes me feel so disgusted about the art itself, almost in a visceral way. Especially cause it was romantic in nature, and now it feels something else entirely.

I was referring to Gaiman. His writing felt like a flowing river to me...not sure if someone else would regard him as "stream of consiousness" exactly but it felt like that to me... @⁨Aditi Bapat KVizzing⁩ ‎
